(There are different kinds of coins such as golden coins, silver coins, copper coins, and a coin that is made of mixed gold, silver, and copper. (Although it is as well Nīlakahāpaṇa, as well Dudradāmakakahāpaṇa, etc., all kinds of money that are made of any kind of metal as per one's country's own currency that is inclusive of money (or) coins).
